newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia to pay off 30 trln rbls in wage arrears.
newsitem.headline: Russia to pay off 30 trln rbls in wage arrears.

text.p: Russia will pay off 5.4 trillion roubles ($939 million) in back wages to the military by September and 25 trillion roubles in other public sector arrears by the end of the year, First Deputy Prime Minister Boris Nemtsov said on Wednesday.
Nemstov, commenting on a decree signed by President Boris Yeltsin on Tuesday, gave the figures at a news conference, a tape of which was obtained by Reuters.

Nemtsov said the debt of 25 trillion roubles was shared by the regional and central budgets. "The government has the right to add one rouble from its own funds to every rouble paid by the regions," he said.
Yeltsin, who is on holiday, met Nemtsov on Tuesday and succumbed to pressure from reformist ministers to delay paying huge wage arrears to public sector workers.
Yeltsin kept his original deadline of September 1 for the payment of back wages to the armed forces but agreed to extend the date for other public sector employees to January 1 from October 1.
The government has not given full details yet of how it intends to raise the money.
